title: Sword Fight And Hitbox As Desired
features:
⚔️The NEMO HITBOX⚔️ control system features four core functions optimized for a seamless user experience:
Hitbox Size (Input Box): The heart of the script, allowing you to freely adjust your attack range. Simply enter a value and press Enter to instantly update the detection zone.
Lock Button (🔓/🔒): This toggle secures the Menu to a specific spot on your screen, preventing you from accidentally dragging the interface during intense combat situations.
Close Button (×): Clears the display space by removing the interface from your screen while keeping the Hitbox logic running silently in the background.
STOP SCRIPT Button: An "emergency exit" that halts all attack loops, disconnects the script, and clears the memory to return the game to its original state.
